findings.evidence: TauCeti/RingTheory/LocalRing/Etale.lean:150 `theorem Polynomial.Monic.isLocalRing_adjoinRoot (hg : g.Monic) (hirr : Irreducible (g.map (residue R)))`, :159 `AdjoinRoot.maximalIdeal_eq_map [IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot g)]`, :166 `AdjoinRoot.isLocalHom_algebraMap` all need only a local `R`. `isPurelyInseparable_residueField_ringYZ` in the same file is already stated under `[IsLocalRing A] [CharP A 2]`.
findings.fix: Move these declarations into a section with `[IsLocalRing A] [CharP A 2]` and `ht : t ∈ maximalIdeal A`, matching `isPurelyInseparable_residueField_ringYZ`. Keep the DVR/domain assumptions only for `isDomain_ringY(Z)`, `isDiscreteValuationRing_ringY(Z)`, `irreducible_algebraMap_ringYZ` and the automorphism/ramification results.
findings.issue: `isLocalRing_ringYZ`, `maximalIdeal_ringYZ`, `isLocalHom_algebraMap_ringYZ` and `finrank_residueField_ringYZ` (and the helpers `isLocalRing_ringY`, `irreducible_map_residue_quadratic_ringYZ`) inherit `[IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]` from `section DiscreteValuationRing`. Their proofs only use `Monic.isLocalRing_adjoinRoot`, `AdjoinRoot.maximalIdeal_eq_map`, `AdjoinRoot.isLocalHom_algebraMap` and `finrank_residueField_eq_finrank`, which need only `IsLocalRing`. The `have := isDomain_ringY` in `finrank_residueField_ringYZ` is unnecessary; `isLocalRing_ringY` already gives nontriviality.

summary: The residue-field and maximal-ideal results for B are stated over a discrete valuation ring A, but their proofs only use local-ring lemmas, so they should hold for any local A of characteristic two. The new general lemmas (AdjoinRoot DVR criterion, residue-degree corollary, char-2 lemmas) are at the natural level.
